parameters.name: GroupNameLike
parameters.description: The name of the protected object group that you want to query. Fuzzy queries are supported.

parameters.name: GroupNames
parameters.description: The names of the protected object groups that you want to query. Separate multiple names with commas (,).

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-defense-resource-groups --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-wwo3600000i --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfmxc7lf0000eq --group-name-like demoGroupName --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --group-names groupName1,groupName2 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
